request.description: Opens the next draft, copying the latest published version unless `content` or `fromNumber` is given. One version can be in progress at a time. Staff only. Consent templates are versioned config (same lifecycle as question sets): compliance makes, a different staff member approves in Change Requests, then compliance publishes. The document key is the context clients ask for (e.g. `journey`, `lead_capture`). Each item's text is hashed so a record proves exactly what the person saw.
